# Introduction

## Website overview:

This website serves as the reproducibility and deployment reference for the Dynamic-Vit implemented by Gabriel François, Avner El Baz and Léo Leroy, inspired by [@rao2021dynamicvit]. 

How to use, ...

# Environment and dependencies

## Requirements

Our code requires Python 3.10+ and the dependencies listed in `requirements.txt` / `pyproject.toml`.

What about Cuda ??

```bash
git clone 
cd Vit-Pytorch
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate  
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

You can also use `uv`:
```bash
uv sync
```

# Project structure 
<!-- on doit vraiment inclure ça dans le website ? -->

Vit-Pytorch/
├── src/
│   ├── models/           # Architecture: ViT, DynamicViT, Patch Embedding, Predictor LG
│   ├── train/            # Training loops for Teacher and Student (CIFAR & ImageNet)
│   ├── test/             # Evaluation scripts and parameter computing
│   └── finetuning/       # LoRA fine-tuning scripts for STL-10
├── configs/              # Hyperparameters and data paths per dataset
├── data/                 # Data loading logic and raw data storage
├── logs/                 # TensorBoard events and generated plots
├── checkpoints/          # Saved model weights (.pth)
├── helper_function/      # Utility functions for printing and formatting
├── pyproject.toml        # Project dependencies and metadata
└── requirements.txt      # Traditional pip requirements
